newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Formosa G Fund to move listing to Ireland.
newsitem.headline: Formosa G Fund to move listing to Ireland.

text.p: Formosa Growth Fund Ltd said on Wednesday it plans to apply for a listing on the Irish Stock Exchange. If accepted, it will withdraw its ordinary shares from listing on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong.

The proposal was subject to approval by members in an extraordinary general meeting of the company on September 26, Formosa said in a statement. If approved, the new listing and withdrawal of listing would both occur before December 31, 1996.
Formosa Growth said the proposed change of listing arrangements would reduce costs, reduce settlement risks and make it easier for the company to issue further shares.
